title: Drawback Chess, But I Can SEE My Drawback
summary: Online Drawback Chess vs random humans where the narrator can see his own drawback (purple drawback site, ~2+1 clocks, Hide/Reveal drawback buttons). Goal: win three games. Game 1 vs 'be kind I'm 100 elo': his drawback 'Guerilla Tactics' (after capturing, the capturing piece must return to its previous square if possible); opponent's 'Paranoid' (your king must always be defended). Game 2: his 'Moving Day' (from move 21 on, your pieces can't be on your home row); opponent's 'Irresistible' (if you can move a piece adjacent to the opponent's king that isn't already, you must). Another opponent had 'Bongcloud' (when your king is on the back rank you can only move ...).
rules: Standard start; Drawback Chess king-capture rules (no check; capture the king to win).
Each side has one random drawback; own drawback visible (with option to hide or reveal it to the opponent), opponent's hidden until the end.

Drawbacks seen: Guerilla Tactics (after capturing, return the capturing piece to its previous square if possible); Paranoid (your king must always be defended); Moving Day (from move 21, none of your pieces may be on your home row); Irresistible (if you can move a piece adjacent to the enemy king that isn't already, you must); Bongcloud (king on back rank restriction); Boxing with shadows; Checkers.
win_condition: Capture the opponent's king; goal win three games.
